17.t: Working with data: a circuit investigation
q: At what voltage did current first flow?
Calculate the mean current at 0.7 V.
Identify the anomaly at 0.8 V and calculate the mean without it.
40 mA is anomalous. Mean of 65 and 70 = 67.5 mA.
Identify the component, with reasons from the data.
A diode: no current below about 0.6 V, then the current rises very steeply. (Reversing it would give no current at all.)
